messages:
maria: opened a PR to fix the /generate example — curl was sending form-data but header said `application/json`. also removed an accidental Content-Length hack. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432
kevin: saw that. small other issue: JS snippet uses model enum `gpt4` but runtime expects `gpt-4` (dash). can we normalise enums across snippets?
maria: yep will update curl + js + python. adding a note about enum casing in the param table. also found the Go example marshals `files` as an object, should be an array — will fix.
sam: assigning to @maria for edits. also double-check streaming example link — current anchor `#streaming-ex` 404s in the nav.
docs-bot: PR opened by maria (docs) — "fix generate examples: content-type, enum casing, sdk snippets" — CI: pending
maria: pushed changes: corrected Content-Type, fixed Go `files` shape, updated JS enum to `gpt-4`. added a Python snippet showing correct header + streaming hint:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4","input":"hello"}'
```
kevin: nice. left one nit — the code fence language tags differ between examples (bash vs sh). prefer `bash` everywhere for curl snippets. also the nav link fix is tracked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/433
maria: standardized fence tags. added a short migration note for legacy clients about the `max_new_tokens` -> `max_tokens` rename. example before/after included.
oliver: reassigning to @emma for a quick runtime shape check (embeds vs generate differences).
emma: quick read: payload shapes look correct. one thing — batch embeddings examples must show both `input: ["a","b"]` and single-string shorthand; added tiny sample to the PR.
maria: added the batch single+array examples, and updated the request/response schema table. CI passed: all green. ready to merge unless anybody objects.
kevin: :thumbsup:
